Join me on an exclusive tour of Nalanda University's stunning new campus in Rajgir, Bihar. This world-class university is a revival of the ancient Nalanda University, which was a renowned center of learning in ancient India.
In this video, we'll take you inside the university's state-of-the-art facilities, showcasing its modern architecture, serene surroundings, and world-class amenities. From the academic buildings to the student hostels, we'll give you a comprehensive tour of the campus.
